descriptionChirho: The proper name Akkub, referring to several individuals in post-exilic literature: a descendant of David (1 Chr 3:24), Levitical gatekeepers (1 Chr 9:17, Ezra 2:42, Neh 7:45, 11:19, 12:25), and a family of temple servants (Ezra 2:45). Multilingual evidence is uniform: eng 'Aqqub/Akkub,' spa 'Acub,' hin 'akkuub,' arb 'aqquwba,' kor 'akgup/akkubeu,' swa 'Akubu.' The conjunction-prefixed form (waw + Akkub) is syntactic coordination ('and Akkub'), not a different referent or sense.
